key.name: prerequisite_met
key.script: needs == '' or any(row.student_id == student_id and row.course_id == needs for row in completed)

variable.name: students_of
variable.script: {c.course_id: [e.student_id for e in enrolments if e.course_id == c.course_id and (needs_of[c.course_id] == '' or any(d.student_id == e.student_id and d.course_id == needs_of[c.course_id] for d in completed))] for c in courses}

key.name: teacher_sessions_in_slot
key.script: sum(row.teacher_id == teacher_id and row.slot_id == slot_id for row in timetable)

key.name: teacher_off
key.script: any(row.teacher_id == teacher_id and row.slot_id == slot_id for row in unavailable)

key.name: room_sessions_in_slot
key.script: sum(row.room_id == room_id and row.slot_id == slot_id for row in timetable)

key.name: student_clashes
key.script: sum(student in students_of[course_id] for row in timetable if row.slot_id == slot_id and row.session_id != session_id for student in students_of[row.course_id])

key.name: sessions_planned
key.script: sum(row.course_id == course_id for row in timetable)

key.name: days
key.script: len({row.day for row in timetable if row.course_id == course_id})

key.name: unexplained
key.script: sum(row['rule'] not in ('T2', 'T3', 'T4', 'T5', 'T6', 'undone') or row['reason'] == '' for row in skipped)
